title: Variable Phase Shift
text: Model variable phase device, 1 input, {Reference impedances (Ohm)} sets Reference impedance for phase shifter; {Phase shift unit} sets the angle units for controlling phase of circuit and {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Phase shift unit
params.values: Angle units for controlling phase of circuit rad (default) | deg

params.name: Reference impedances (Ohm)
params.values: Reference impedance for phase shifter 50 (default) | vector of real positive scalars | real scalar

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: Ground RF circuit terminals on (default) | off
